title: نامه‌ای که پرنده شد
logline_fa: نامه‌ای با خطی روان نوشته می‌شود؛ حرف آخرش بلند می‌شود، کاغذ تا می‌شود و نامه پرنده‌ای می‌شود که از پنجره پرواز می‌کند و کلمه «پیام» را با خود می‌برد.
ratio_note: 9x16 first; 16:9 as a wide window composition

protagonist.what: a Persian word on a folded letter that becomes a bird
protagonist.build: word as SVG text with a stroke-dash or clip reveal (joins intact); fold = 2 polygons transforming; bird = path morph between paper and wings (same point count)
protagonist.state_change: written letter -> folded paper -> bird in flight with the word on its wing

beats.what: letter written, word reveals right to left with joins intact
bird forms and flaps; window opens
bird flies out, camera follows; copy

payoffs.viewer_gets: the word completes with an underline flourish
paper folds sharply with a crease line
window light floods, bird leaves the frame

assets: SVG word using the fa kit font (joined text), paper polygons, bird path, window
kit sfx: pen scratch, paper snap, wing flap, shimmer

tests: path morph with same point count
likely_skill_gaps: right-to-left reveal clip may cut glyph overhangs
acceptance: font check: no fallback font in captured frames
transition strip: morph has no pop
run-gates edge-touch clean in both ratios
